description_en: Provides feedback on OSS detection results
kebab_example: aliyun green mark-oss-v2-result --request-ids AAAAAA-BBBB-CCCCC-DDDD-EEEEEEEE0000 --task-name '图片存量任务_20240914100517757' --operation freeze --start-date 2023-08-21_16:08:38_+0800 --end-date 2023-10-21_16:08:38_+0800 --freeze-type ACL --api-version 2022-09-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MarkOssV2Result

parameters.help_en:
The processing operation. Valid values:

freeze: Freeze.
unfreeze: Unfreeze.
misreport: False positive (not a violation).
missOut: Missed violation
parameters.help_zh:
处置操作。

freeze 冻结。
unfreeze 解冻。
misreport 未违规误报。
missOut 违规漏过
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。时间格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。时间格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The freeze type. This parameter is required when Operation is set to freeze. Valid values:
ACL: Modify file permissions.
COPY: Move the file to a directory. Directory description: 1. The directory selected when the task was created takes priority. 2. If automatic freezing was not enabled during creation, or ACL freezing was configured, the directory selected during manual freezing in the console is used. 3. The default directory is alicip_riskfile_backup/
parameters.help_zh:
冻结类型，Operation取值为freeze时必填。
ACL：修改文件权限
COPY：移动文件目录，目标目录说明：1. 优先取任务创建时选择的文件目录。2. 若创建时没开启自动冻结，或配置的是ACL冻结，则选择用户控制台冻结时选择的目录。3. 默认目录 alicip_riskfile_backup/
parameters.name: freeze_type
